address: 95 Bidborough Ridge, Royal Tunbridge Wells, Bidborough, TN3 0XB, United Kingdom
bio: Behind the clapboard façade sits a spacious bar with bookshelf wallpaper and a modern extension where you can watch the chefs cooking steaks on two Big Green Eggs. Care is taken both in sourcing and cooking, and dishes are boldly flavoured and well-presented. Simpler dishes are available on the bar menu....
